added.summary: `Flourish`, the engine's UI effect presets: it wraps what it decorates (an icon, a slot, a price, a button) and plays over it, once per shot with its pack sound and at three to four times its size, a `reward` (flash, rays, ring, star glints, motes), a `levelUp` (screen wash, column of light, rays, rising stars), a `purchase` (a fountain of spinning coins catching the light, the target popping), a `reveal` that charges (glints drawn in, a swelling glow, the target gathering), bursts and settles, richer by `rarity` (rays from rare, more from epic, a column and a screen wash from legendary), or, while it shows, a `highlight` (an aura in the pack's `art-primary`, a sweeping sheen, twinkling stars). Built on `Particles`: fourteen emitters in components/hud/fx/ and six particle textures the default pack carries as the images `fx-sparkle`, `fx-glint`, `fx-shard`, `fx-coin`, `fx-ray` and `fx-ring`, which a game's own emitters can name too (`texture "@styles/shared/fx/sparkle.png"`).

The theme colour `art-primary`, the primary button art's own colour (gold in the default pack, cyan in scifi, red in fantasy, yellow in cartoon): what lights it, such as a highlight's aura (`bg-art-primary`, `shadow-art-primary`).
